descriptions.en: While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are stored in the seed on its back in order to grow.
descriptions.pt-BR: Enquanto jovem, ele utiliza os nutrientes que estão armazenados na semente em seu dorso para crescer.

descriptions.en: Exposure to sunlight adds to its strength. Sunlight also makes the bud on its back grow larger.
A bewitching aroma wafts from its flower. The fragrance becalms those engaged in a battle.
descriptions.pt-BR: Um aroma encantador exala de sua flor. A fragrância acalma aqueles que estão envolvidos em uma batalha.

descriptions.en: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.
descriptions.pt-BR: Desde o nascimento, uma chama arde na ponta da cauda. Sua vida terminaria se a chama se apagasse.

descriptions.en: If it becomes agitated during battle, it spouts intense flames, incinerating its surroundings.
Its wings can carry this Pokémon close to an altitude of 4,600 feet. It blows out fire at very high temperatures.
descriptions.pt-BR: Suas asas podem transportar este Pokémon a uma altitude de até 4.600 pés. Ele expele chamas a temperaturas muito altas.

descriptions.en: When it feels threatened, it draws its limbs inside its shell and sprays water from its mouth.
descriptions.pt-BR: Quando se sente ameaçado, ele puxa os membros para dentro da concha e espirra água pela boca.

descriptions.en: It cleverly controls its furry ears and tail to maintain its balance while swimming.
The rocket cannons on its shell fire jets of water capable of punching holes through thick steel.
descriptions.pt-BR: Os canhões de foguete em seu projétil disparam jatos de água capazes de perfurar aço grosso.

descriptions.en: Its short feet are tipped with suction pads that enable it to tirelessly climb slopes and walls.
Even though it is encased in a sturdy shell, the body inside is tender. It can’t withstand a harsh attack.
It collects honey every day. It rubs honey onto the hairs on its legs to carry it back to its nest.
descriptions.pt-BR: Coleta mel todos os dias. Ele esfrega mel nos pelos das pernas para carregá-lo de volta ao ninho.

descriptions.en: Beware of the sharp stinger on its head. It hides in grass and bushes where it eats leaves.
Able to move only slightly. When endangered, it may stick out its stinger and poison its enemy.
It has three poisonous stingers on its forelegs and its tail. They are used to jab its enemy repeatedly.
Very docile. If attacked, it will often kick up sand to protect itself rather than fight back.
This Pokémon is full of vitality. It constantly flies around its large territory in search of prey.
This Pokémon flies at Mach 2 speed, seeking prey. Its large talons are feared as wicked weapons.
descriptions.pt-BR: Este Pokémon voa na velocidade Mach 2 em busca de presas. Suas grandes garras são temidas como armas malignas.

descriptions.en: Will chew on anything with its fangs. If you see one, you can be certain that 40 more live in the area.
Its hind feet are webbed. They act as flippers, so it can swim in rivers and hunt for prey.
Inept at flying high. However, it can fly around very fast to protect its territory.
A Pokémon that dates back many years. If it senses danger, it flies high and away, instantly.
The older it gets, the longer it grows. At night, it wraps its long body around tree branches to rest.
The frightening patterns on its belly have been studied. Six variations have been confirmed.
descriptions.pt-BR: Os padrões assustadores em sua barriga foram estudados. Seis variações foram confirmadas.

descriptions.en: Possesses cheek sacs in which it stores electricity. This clever forest-dweller roasts tough berries with an electric shock before consuming them.
descriptions.pt-BR: Possui bolsas nas bochechas nas quais armazena eletricidade. Este inteligente morador da floresta torra bagas duras com um choque elétrico antes de consumi-las.

descriptions.en: It can discharge bursts of electricity exceeding 100,000 volts— a single strike with that amount of power would incapacitate one of the Copperajah of my homeland.
descriptions.pt-BR: Ele pode descarregar rajadas de eletricidade superiores a 100.000 volts – um único ataque com essa quantidade de energia incapacitaria um dos Copperajah da minha terra natal.

descriptions.en: It burrows into the ground to create its nest. If hard stones impede its tunneling, it uses its sharp claws to shatter them and then carries on digging.
It climbs trees by hooking on with its sharp claws. Sandslash shares the berries it gathers, dropping them down to Sandshrew waiting below the tree.
It uses its hard incisor teeth to crush and eat berries. The tip of a female Nidoran’s horn is a bit more rounded than the tip of a male’s horn.
If the group is threatened, these Pokémon will band together to assault enemies with a chorus of ultrasonic waves.
It pacifies offspring by placing them in the gaps between the spines on its back. The spines will never secrete poison while young are present.
Small but brave, this Pokémon will hold its ground and even risk its life in battle to protect the female it’s friendly with.
It’s nervous and quick to act aggressively. The potency of its poison increases along with the level of adrenaline present in its body.
Nidoking prides itself on its strength. It’s forceful and spirited in battle, making use of its thick tail and diamond-crushing horn.
descriptions.pt-BR: Nidoking se orgulha de sua força. É forte e espirituoso em batalha, fazendo uso de sua cauda grossa e chifre esmagador de diamantes.

descriptions.en: It can be found in quiet mountain areas on a full moon's night. Its dancing and its tiny, faintly glowing wings confer upon it a lovely fairylike quality.
Legend says that on clear, quiet nights, it listens for the voices of its kin living on the moon. I, too, often think of my homeland, so far away.
descriptions.pt-BR: A lenda diz que em noites claras e tranquilas, ele escuta as vozes dos seus parentes que vivem na lua. Também eu penso muitas vezes na minha terra natal, tão distante.

descriptions.en: In its belly burns a fire, which Vulpix spits out in the form of fireballs. When young, this Pokémon has but one white tail. As the Pokémon matures, this single tail splits into six.
The coat of gleaming golden fur is quite magnificent. This species is said to store sacred power in its nine long tails and to live for a millennium.
descriptions.pt-BR: A pelagem dourada brilhante é bastante magnífica. Diz-se que esta espécie armazena poder sagrado em suas nove longas caudas e vive por um milênio.

descriptions.en: By freely changing the wavelength of its voice, Jigglypuff sings a mysterious melody sure to make any listener sleepy.
It’s proud of its fur, which is fine and delicate. In particular, the curl on its forehead has a texture that’s perfectly heavenly.
Makes its home in gloomy caves. Atrophied eyes have left this Pokémon blind, so it scans its surroundings via sound waves that it emits from its mouth as it flies.
It sinks its sharp fangs into other creatures and slurps up their blood. A closer look at the fangs reveals that they are hollow and akin to straws.
descriptions.pt-BR: Ele afunda suas presas afiadas em outras criaturas e suga seu sangue. Um olhar mais atento às presas revela que elas são ocas e semelhantes a canudos.

descriptions.en: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.
What appears to be drool is actually sweet honey. It is very sticky and clings stubbornly if touched.
The larger its petals, the more toxic pollen it contains. Its big head is heavy and hard to hold up.
descriptions.pt-BR: Quanto maiores forem suas pétalas, mais pólen tóxico ela contém. Sua cabeça grande é pesada e difícil de segurar.

descriptions.en: Sometimes seen at the foot of trees in humid forests. The mushrooms on its back—called tochukaso—are not present on infant specimens and instead emerge as Paras matures.
Mushroom-lacking specimens of this Pokémon lie unmoving in the forest, lending credence to the hypothesis that the large mushroom is in control of Parasect's actions.
Its large eyes act as radar. In a bright place, you can see that they are clusters of many tiny eyes.
The powdery scales on its wings are hard to remove from skin. They also contain poison that leaks out on contact.
It burrows through the ground at a shallow depth. It leaves raised earth in its wake, making it easy to spot.
These Diglett triplets dig over 60 miles below sea level. No one knows what it’s like underground.
It washes its face regularly to keep the coin on its forehead spotless. It doesn’t get along with Galarian Meowth.
Its elegant and refined behavior clashes with that of the barbaric Perrserker. The relationship between the two is one of mutual disdain.
Suffers perpetual headaches. If the agony grows too great, Psyduck's latent power erupts, contrary to Psyduck's intent. Ergo, I am exploring ways to ease the pain.
Its body is strong, and it has webbing on its hands and feet. Golduck can swim easily through rough seas, clawing its way through the high waves.
descriptions.pt-BR: Seu corpo é forte e possui membranas nas mãos e nos pés. Golduck pode nadar facilmente em mares agitados, abrindo caminho através das ondas altas.

descriptions.en: An agile Pokémon that lives in trees. It angers easily and will not hesitate to attack anything.
It stops being angry only when nobody else is around. To view this moment is very difficult.
They patrol their territory in pairs. I believe the igneous rock components in the fur of this species are the result of volcanic activity in its habitat.
Snaps at its foes with fangs cloaked in blazing flame. Despite its bulk, it deftly feints every which way, leading opponents on a deceptively merry chase as it all but dances around them.
descriptions.pt-BR: Ataca seus inimigos com presas envoltas em chamas ardentes. Apesar de seu tamanho, ele finta habilmente em todas as direções, conduzindo os oponentes em uma perseguição enganosamente alegre enquanto praticamente dança ao redor deles.

descriptions.en: In rivers with fast-flowing water, this Pokémon will cling to a rock by using its thick lips, which act like a suction cup.
This Pokémon’s sweat is a slimy mucus. When captured, Poliwhirl can slither from its enemies’ grasp and escape.
Poliwrath is skilled at both swimming and martial arts. It uses its well-trained arms to dish out powerful punches.
Spends 18 hours of the day sleeping. Even while asleep, Abra can control its psychic powers—should danger approach, the Pokémon will simply teleport away.
There are rumors that a child with mystical powers became a Kadabra; however, this remains unverified. I suspect that the spoon Kadabra holds enhances its brain waves.
The longer Alakazam lives, the larger and heavier its head becomes. Our tests have shown that the strength of its psychic powers correlates positively to the weight of its head.
descriptions.pt-BR: Quanto mais Alakazam vive, maior e mais pesada se torna sua cabeça. Nossos testes mostraram que a força dos seus poderes psíquicos se correlaciona positivamente com o peso da sua cabeça.

descriptions.en: Though as small as a child, it has strength enough to easily throw a well-built adult. Striving to become ever stronger, Machop trains by carrying a Graveler on its shoulders.
A sturdy creature boasting a robust physique and boundless stamina. Loves training above all else and voluntarily assists with tasks such as construction and clearing land.
In close combat, its four arms afford it offensive and defensive supremacy. In but a blink, this valiant Pokémon can overwhelm its foes with more than 1,000 blows from its fists.
descriptions.pt-BR: No combate corpo a corpo, seus quatro braços proporcionam supremacia ofensiva e defensiva. Num piscar de olhos, este valente Pokémon pode dominar seus inimigos com mais de 1.000 golpes de seus punhos.

descriptions.en: Prefers hot and humid places. It ensnares tiny bugs with its vines and devours them.
When hungry, it swallows anything that moves. Its hapless prey is dissolved by strong acids.
Lures prey with the sweet aroma of honey. Swallowed whole, the prey is dissolved in a day, bones and all.
descriptions.pt-BR: Atrai as presas com o doce aroma do mel. Engolida inteira, a presa se dissolve em um dia, com ossos e tudo.

descriptions.en: They fire beams from the glassy, magenta orbs that resemble eyes atop their heads, and they drift in shallow seas. During low tide, they can sometimes be found on beaches, desiccated.
It has 80 tentacles, each with a venomous tip. These tentacles are also extendible, lengthening when Tentacruel attempts to catch prey. Use caution.
descriptions.pt-BR: Possui 80 tentáculos, cada um com uma ponta venenosa. Esses tentáculos também são extensíveis, alongando-se quando Tentacruel tenta capturar uma presa. Tenha cuidado.

descriptions.en: Makes its home in mountainous regions, using its arms to climb along harsh mountain roads. Can be troublesome—carelessly kicking one will cause it to fly into a rage and chase after you.
Dwells in holes dug into sheer walls of stone. It enjoys rolling down slopes as though it were a boulder during a rockfall, so keep an eye upward while traversing mountain roads.
The rocklike shell is shed each year. The cast-off shell then crumbles, reverting to a mass of soil, which can be spread across fields to promote crop growth.
descriptions.pt-BR: A concha rochosa é eliminada a cada ano. A casca descartada então se desintegra, revertendo para uma massa de solo, que pode ser espalhada pelos campos para promover o crescimento das culturas.

descriptions.en: These Pokémon live in herds out in the grassland. Newborn foals lack their fiery manes, which will develop about an hour after birth.
Fiery mane aglow, Rapidash darts like an arrow across the land. This prodigiously swift creature can traverse the vast region of Hisui in a day and a half.
descriptions.pt-BR: Com a juba ardente e brilhante, Rapidash dispara como uma flecha pela terra. Esta criatura prodigiosamente rápida pode atravessar a vasta região de Hisui em um dia e meio.

descriptions.en: When this Pokémon’s tail is soaked in water, sweetness seeps from it. Slowpoke uses this trait to lure in and fish up other Pokémon.
Being bitten by a Shellder shocked this Pokémon into standing on two legs. If the Shellder lets go, it seems Slowbro will turn back into a Slowpoke.
descriptions.pt-BR: Ser mordido por um Shellder fez com que este Pokémon ficasse sobre duas pernas. Se o Shellder o soltar, parece que Slowbro voltará a ser um Slowpoke.

descriptions.en: A bizarre Pokémon with but a single eye embedded in an iron sphere. I suspect this creature levitates due to the magnetism it emits from its arms, which resemble horseshoe-shaped magnets.
Three Magnemite gathered to evolve into this Pokémon. The source of much vexation on my part, as its powerful magnetism destroys my research equipment.
descriptions.pt-BR: Três Magnemite se reuniram para evoluir para este Pokémon. A fonte de muita irritação da minha parte, pois seu poderoso magnetismo destrói meu equipamento de pesquisa.

descriptions.en: They use a plant stalk as a weapon, but not all of them use it in the same way. Several distinct styles of stalk fighting have been observed.
Its short wings make flying difficult. Instead, this Pokémon runs at high speed on developed legs.
One of Doduo’s two heads splits to form a unique species. It runs close to 40 mph in prairies.
Loves freezing-cold conditions. Relishes swimming in a frigid climate of around 14 degrees Fahrenheit.
Its entire body is a snowy white. Unharmed by even intense cold, it swims powerfully in icy waters.
descriptions.pt-BR: Todo o seu corpo é branco como a neve. Ignorado mesmo pelo frio intenso, ele nada poderosamente em águas geladas.

descriptions.en: Made of congealed sludge. It smells too putrid to touch. Even weeds won’t grow in its path.
Smells so awful, it can cause fainting. Through degeneration of its nose, it lost its sense of smell.
Its hard shell repels any kind of attack. It is vulnerable only when its shell is open.
Once it slams its shell shut, it is impossible to open, even by those with superior strength.
descriptions.pt-BR: Depois de fechar a concha, é impossível abri-la, mesmo por aqueles com força superior.

descriptions.en: Gaseous and completely impalpable. Also highly dangerous— inhaling part of its poisonous body will cause one to faint instantly.
This frightful, malevolent spirit can glide through walls, appearing wherever it likes. According to rumor, victims of a Haunter's lick will wither to death day by day.
descriptions.pt-BR: Este espírito assustador e malévolo pode deslizar através das paredes, aparecendo onde quiser. Segundo rumores, as vítimas da lambida de um Haunter murcharão até a morte dia após dia.

descriptions.en: Possesses potential victims' shadows in an effort to steal away the victims' lives. If your shadow begins to laugh, you must take hold of a protective charm posthaste!
descriptions.pt-BR: Possui as sombras das vítimas em potencial em um esforço para roubar a vida das vítimas. Se sua sombra começar a rir, você deve usar um amuleto protetor o mais rápido possível!

descriptions.en: This chain of immense stones resembles a giant serpent. Tremors shake the earth above as it burrows deep beneath the ground, feeding on boulders as it goes.
If you sleep by it all the time, it will sometimes show you dreams it had eaten in the past.
Avoid eye contact if you come across one. It will try to put you to sleep by using its pendulum.
descriptions.pt-BR: Evite contato visual se você encontrar um. Ele tentará fazer você dormir usando seu pêndulo.

descriptions.en: If it senses danger approaching, it cloaks itself with bubbles from its mouth so it will look bigger.
Its oversized claw is very powerful, but when it’s not in battle, the claw just gets in the way.
An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.
The tissue on the surface of its body is curiously similar in composition to an Apricorn. When irritated, this Pokémon lets loose an electric current equal to 20 lightning bolts.
descriptions.pt-BR: O tecido na superfície do seu corpo é curiosamente semelhante em composição a um Apricórnio. Quando irritado, este Pokémon libera uma corrente elétrica igual a 20 raios.

descriptions.en: These Pokémon get nervous when they’re not in a group of six. The minute even one member of the group goes missing, Exeggcute become cowardly.
When they work together, Exeggutor’s three heads can put out powerful psychic energy. Cloudy days make this Pokémon sluggish.
This Pokémon wears the skull of its deceased mother. Sometimes Cubone’s dreams make it cry, but each tear Cubone sheds makes it stronger.
When this Pokémon evolved, the skull of its mother fused to it. Marowak’s temperament also turned vicious at the same time.
descriptions.pt-BR: Quando este Pokémon evoluiu, o crânio de sua mãe se fundiu a ele. O temperamento de Marowak também se tornou cruel ao mesmo tempo.

descriptions.en: The legs freely contract and stretch. The stretchy legs allow it to hit a distant foe with a rising kick.
descriptions.pt-BR: As pernas se contraem e esticam livremente. As pernas elásticas permitem atingir um inimigo distante com um chute ascendente.

descriptions.en: Its punches slice the air. However, it seems to need a short break after fighting for three minutes.
descriptions.pt-BR: Seus socos cortam o ar. No entanto, parece precisar de uma pequena pausa depois de três minutos de luta.

descriptions.en: Wields its long tongue deftly, as though it were an arm. The Pokémon's viscous saliva, once it has been collected and boiled down, yields a strong and highly useful adhesive.
It adores polluted air. Some claim that Koffing used to be more plentiful in the Galar region than they are now.
It can’t suck in air quite as well as a Galarian Weezing, but the toxins it creates are more potent than those of its counterpart.
descriptions.pt-BR: Ele não consegue sugar o ar tão bem quanto um Galarian Weezing, mas as toxinas que ele cria são mais potentes do que as de seu equivalente.

descriptions.en: Ludicrously strong—when it butts heads with a mountain, it is the mountain that shatters. But its short legs struggle with turns, and it is incapable of stopping unless it collides with something.
Rapidly rotates its horn to bore through bedrock. It swaggers around volcanic regions, protected from the lava's heat by its tough, armorlike hide.
descriptions.pt-BR: Gira rapidamente seu chifre para perfurar a rocha. Ele anda por regiões vulcânicas, protegido do calor da lava por sua pele resistente e semelhante a uma armadura.

descriptions.en: This purehearted Pokémon shares its eggs with the injured.
It is cloaked entirely in blue vines, preventing any glimpse of its true identity. The vines impart a refreshing sensation when chewed—they're useful as a spice.
descriptions.pt-BR: Está inteiramente coberto por vinhas azuis, impedindo qualquer vislumbre de sua verdadeira identidade. As vinhas transmitem uma sensação refrescante quando mastigadas – são úteis como tempero.

descriptions.en: There are records of a lost human child being raised by a childless Kangaskhan.
They swim with dance-like motions and cause whirlpools to form. Horsea compete to see which of them can generate the biggest whirlpool.
Seadra’s mouth is slender, but its suction power is strong. In an instant, Seadra can suck in food that’s larger than the opening of its mouth.
Its dorsal and pectoral fins are strongly developed like muscles. It can swim at a speed of five knots.
Using its horn, it bores holes in riverbed boulders, making nests to prevent its eggs from washing away.
Fish Pokémon nibble at it, but Staryu isn’t bothered. Its body regenerates quickly, even if part of it is completely torn off.
Starmie swims by spinning its body at high speed. As this Pokémon cruises through the ocean, it absorbs tiny plankton.
descriptions.pt-BR: Starmie nada girando seu corpo em alta velocidade. À medida que este Pokémon navega pelo oceano, ele absorve minúsculos plânctons.

descriptions.en: The behavior of this clown-like Pokémon reminds one of pantomime. It creates invisible walls using a force emitted from its fingertips.
The large, wickedly sharp scythes on its forearms are truly fearsome weapons. Prey's attempts to flee are unfailingly thwarted by this Pokémon's nimble motions.
descriptions.pt-BR: As foices grandes e afiadas em seus antebraços são armas verdadeiramente temíveis. As tentativas de fuga de Prey são infalivelmente frustradas pelos movimentos ágeis deste Pokémon.

descriptions.en: The Jynx of Galar often have beautiful and delicate voices. Some of these Pokémon have even gathered a fan base.
descriptions.pt-BR: Os Jynx de Galar costumam ter vozes lindas e delicadas. Alguns desses Pokémon até reuniram uma base de fãs.

descriptions.en: Feeds on electrical energy. During sudden showers beneath looming thunderclouds, one can observe Electabuzz scaling tall trees, where the Pokémon will then wait for lightning to strike.
descriptions.pt-BR: Alimenta-se de energia elétrica. Durante chuvas repentinas sob nuvens de trovoada iminentes, pode-se observar Electabuzz escalando árvores altas, onde o Pokémon esperará que um raio caia.

descriptions.en: Legend has it that this Pokémon was born from the crater of a volcano. When wounded, it bathes in lava to heal its body, much as one would soak in a hot spring.
descriptions.pt-BR: Diz a lenda que este Pokémon nasceu da cratera de um vulcão. Quando ferido, ele se banha em lava para curar seu corpo, da mesma forma que alguém mergulharia em uma fonte termal.

descriptions.en: This Pokémon clamps its pincers down on its prey and then either splits the prey in half or flings it away.
descriptions.pt-BR: Este Pokémon aperta suas pinças sobre sua presa e depois a divide ao meio ou a arremessa fora.

descriptions.en: The Tauros of the Galar region are volatile in nature, and they won’t allow people to ride on their backs.
descriptions.pt-BR: Os Tauros da região de Galar são voláteis por natureza e não permitem que as pessoas andem nas suas costas.

descriptions.en: A feeble, pitiful imbecile of a Pokémon that is nonetheless very hardy. Unperturbed by turbid water, it can be found living in all sorts of places.
I suspect this Pokémon to be the true identity of a dragon written of in ancient texts, which claimed that it razed an entire village with white-hot beams from its maw.
descriptions.pt-BR: Eu suspeito que este Pokémon seja a verdadeira identidade de um dragão mencionado em textos antigos, que afirmavam que ele arrasou uma vila inteira com raios incandescentes de sua boca.

descriptions.en: Crossing icy seas is no issue for this cold-resistant Pokémon. Its smooth skin is a little cool to the touch.
descriptions.pt-BR: Cruzar mares gelados não é problema para este Pokémon resistente ao frio. Sua pele lisa é um pouco fria ao toque.

descriptions.en: When it encounters another Ditto, it will move faster than normal to duplicate that opponent exactly.
Harbors the potential to evolve into manifold forms. Within Eevee lies the key to the mysteries of Pokémon evolution—I'm certain of it.
descriptions.pt-BR: Abriga o potencial para evoluir em múltiplas formas. Dentro do Eevee está a chave para os mistérios da evolução Pokémon – tenho certeza disso.

descriptions.en: Tests show that its cells closely resemble water molecules, which perhaps explains its ability to conceal its form while submerged. I believe the origins of mermaid folklore lie with this Pokémon.
descriptions.pt-BR: Os testes mostram que as suas células se assemelham muito às moléculas de água, o que talvez explique a sua capacidade de ocultar a sua forma enquanto está submerso. Acredito que as origens do folclore das sereias estão neste Pokémon.

descriptions.en: Bristles its fur into sharp, needlelike points when enraged. One can hear electricity crackle in its breath when it exhales.
descriptions.pt-BR: Eriça seu pelo em pontas afiadas como agulhas quando enfurecido. Pode-se ouvir a eletricidade estalando em sua respiração quando ela expira.

descriptions.en: Flames burn within a saclike organ inside this Pokémon. When Flareon inhales, these flames grow in intensity, reaching a mighty 3,000 degrees Fahrenheit.
descriptions.pt-BR: Chamas queimam dentro de um órgão em forma de saco dentro deste Pokémon. Quando Flareon inala, essas chamas aumentam de intensidade, atingindo poderosos 3.000 graus Fahrenheit.

descriptions.en: It has no discernible heartbeat and does not seem to draw breath, and yet it appears to function without issue. I cannot even begin to explain this utterly bizarre anomaly.
This Pokémon is a member of an ancient, extinct species. Omanyte paddles through water with its 10 tentacles, looking like it’s just drifting along.
Omastar’s sharp fangs could crush rock, but the Pokémon can attack only the prey that come within reach of its tentacles.
While some say this species has gone extinct, Kabuto sightings are apparently fairly common in some places.
The cause behind the extinction of this species is unknown. Kabutops were aggressive Pokémon that inhabited warm seas.
Aerodactyl’s sawlike fangs can shred skin to tatters—even the skin of Steel-type Pokémon.
descriptions.pt-BR: As presas em forma de serra do Aerodactyl podem despedaçar a pele, até mesmo a pele de Pokémon do tipo Aço.

descriptions.en: This glutton appears in villages without warning and devours the entirety of their rice granaries—such occurrences have long been counted among the gravest of disasters.
descriptions.pt-BR: Este glutão aparece nas aldeias sem aviso prévio e devora todos os seus celeiros de arroz – tais ocorrências têm sido consideradas entre os mais graves desastres.

descriptions.en: This Pokémon can control ice at will. Articuno is said to live in snowy mountains riddled with permafrost.
descriptions.pt-BR: Este Pokémon pode controlar o gelo à vontade. Diz-se que Articuno vive em montanhas nevadas repletas de permafrost.

descriptions.en: Zapdos is a legendary bird Pokémon. It’s said that when Zapdos rubs its feathers together, lightning will fall immediately after.
descriptions.pt-BR: Zapdos é um Pokémon pássaro lendário. Dizem que quando Zapdos esfrega as penas, um raio cai imediatamente em seguida.

descriptions.en: There are stories of this Pokémon using its radiant, flame-cloaked wings to light up paths for those lost in the mountains.
descriptions.pt-BR: Há histórias deste Pokémon usando suas asas radiantes e cobertas de chamas para iluminar caminhos para aqueles que estão perdidos nas montanhas.

descriptions.en: This Pokémon was long considered to be no more than a myth. The small lump on a Dratini’s forehead is actually a horn that’s still coming in.
This Pokémon gathers power in the orbs on its tail and controls the weather. When enshrouded by an aura, Dragonair has a mystical appearance.
This Pokémon is known as the Sea Incarnate. Figureheads that resemble Dragonite decorate the bows of many ships.
descriptions.pt-BR: Este Pokémon é conhecido como Sea Incarnate. Figuras de proa que lembram Dragonite decoram a proa de muitos navios.

descriptions.en: Its DNA is almost the same as Mew’s. However, its size and disposition are vastly different.
descriptions.pt-BR: Seu DNA é quase igual ao de Mew. No entanto, seu tamanho e disposição são muito diferentes.

descriptions.en: When viewed through a microscope, this Pokémon’s short, fine, delicate hair can be seen.
descriptions.pt-BR: Quando visto através de um microscópio, o cabelo curto, fino e delicado deste Pokémon pode ser visto.

descriptions.en: In battle, Chikorita waves its leaf around to keep the foe at bay. However, a sweet fragrance also wafts from the leaf, becalming the battling Pokémon and creating a cozy, friendly atmosphere all around.
Bayleef’s neck is ringed by curled-up leaves. Inside each tubular leaf is a small shoot of a tree. The fragrance of this shoot makes people peppy.
The fragrance of Meganium’s flower soothes and calms emotions. In battle, this Pokémon gives off more of its becalming scent to blunt the foe’s fighting spirit.
descriptions.pt-BR: A fragrância da flor de Meganium acalma e acalma as emoções. Em batalha, este Pokémon exala mais do seu cheiro calmante para enfraquecer o espírito de luta do inimigo.

descriptions.en: Hails from the Johto region. Though usually curled into a ball due to its timid disposition, it harbors tremendous firepower.
This creature's fur is most mysterious—it is wholly impervious to the burning touch of flame. Should Quilava turn its back to you, take heed! Such a posture indicates a forthcoming attack.
Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. I believe its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui's center.
descriptions.pt-BR: Diz-se que purifica almas perdidas e abandonadas com suas chamas e as guia para a vida após a morte. Acredito que a sua forma foi influenciada pela energia da montanha sagrada que se eleva no centro de Hisui.

descriptions.en: Despite the smallness of its body, Totodile’s jaws are very powerful. While the Pokémon may think it is just playfully nipping, its bite has enough power to cause serious injury.

Once Croconaw has clamped its jaws on its foe, it will absolutely not let go. Because the tips of its fangs are forked back like barbed fishhooks, they become impossible to remove when they have sunk in.
Feraligatr intimidates its foes by opening its huge mouth. In battle, it will kick the ground hard with its thick and powerful hind legs to charge at the foe at an incredible speed.
descriptions.pt-BR: Feraligatr intimida seus inimigos abrindo sua boca enorme. Na batalha, ele chutará o chão com força com suas patas traseiras grossas e poderosas para atacar o inimigo a uma velocidade incrível.

descriptions.en: When Sentret sleeps, it does so while another stands guard. The sentry wakes the others at the first sign of danger. When this Pokémon becomes separated from its pack, it becomes incapable of sleep due to fear.
Furret has a very slim build. When under attack, it can slickly squirm through narrow spaces and get away. In spite of its short limbs, this Pokémon is very nimble and fleet.
It begins to hoot at the same time every day. Some Trainers use them in place of clocks.
When it needs to think, it rotates its head 180 degrees to sharpen its intellectual power.
descriptions.pt-BR: Quando precisa pensar, gira a cabeça 180 graus para aguçar seu poder intelectual.

descriptions.en: These very cowardly Pokémon join together and use Reflect to protect their nest.
It flies through the night sky, sprinkling sparkly dust. According to some, if that dust sticks to you, good things will happen to you.
Although the poison from its fangs isn’t that strong, it’s potent enough to weaken prey that gets caught in its web.
It spews threads from its mouth to catch its prey. When night falls, it leaves its web to go hunt aggressively.
descriptions.pt-BR: Ele cospe fios de sua boca para capturar sua presa. Quando a noite cai, ele deixa sua teia para caçar agressivamente.

descriptions.en: Its hind limbs have become another set of wings. Crobat expertly maneuvers its four wings to dart in exquisite fashion through even the most confined caves without losing any speed.
On the dark ocean floor, its only means of communication is its constantly flashing lights.
This Pokémon flashes a bright light that blinds its prey. This creates an opening for it to deliver an electrical attack.
descriptions.pt-BR: Este Pokémon emite uma luz brilhante que cega sua presa. Isso cria uma abertura para que ele possa realizar um ataque elétrico.

descriptions.en: Pichu stores electricity in the sacs on its cheeks but discharges it inadvertently when agitated or excited. Being yet immature, the Pokémon's handling of electricity is rather inept.
In silhouette, they resemble twinkling starlight. When shooting stars rain from the night sky, Cleffa gather in numbers and dance as though they are indeed incarnations of the stars.
Taking advantage of the softness of its body, Igglybuff moves as if bouncing. Its body turns a deep pink when its temperature rises.
This ovate creature is frequently mistaken for a moving egg when encountered out in the fields or in the mountains. Its guileless smile soothes the soul.
No records exist of Togetic being seen in the wilds. Rumors abound that it evolves under the loving care of a trusted human companion, upon whom the Pokémon then bestows great joy.
Because its wings aren’t yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.
This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun’s movement all day.
descriptions.pt-BR: Este estranho Pokémon pode ver o passado e o futuro. Ele observa o movimento do sol o dia todo.

descriptions.en: Rubbing its fleece generates electricity. You’ll want to pet it because it’s cute, but if you use your bare hand, you’ll get a painful shock.
It stores electricity in its fluffy fleece. If it stores up too much, it will start to go bald in those patches.
Its tail shines bright and strong. It has been prized since long ago as a beacon for sailors.
descriptions.pt-BR: Sua cauda brilha forte e brilhante. É apreciado há muito tempo como um farol para os marinheiros.

descriptions.en: Bellossom gather at times and appear to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.
descriptions.pt-BR: Bellossom às vezes se reúne e parece dançar. Dizem que a dança é um ritual para invocar o sol.

descriptions.en: Even after Marill swims in a cold sea, its water- repellent fur dries almost as soon as Marill leaves the water. That’s why this Pokémon is never cold.
These Pokémon create air-filled bubbles. When Azurill play in rivers, Azumarill will cover them with these bubbles.
descriptions.pt-BR: Esses Pokémon criam bolhas cheias de ar. Quando o Azurill joga nos rios, o Azumarill irá cobri-los com essas bolhas.

descriptions.en: Though it pretends to be a tree, it fails to fool even children. To the touch, its body feels more like rock than tree bark. Sudowoodo's extreme aversion to water merits special note.
descriptions.pt-BR: Embora finja ser uma árvore, não consegue enganar nem mesmo as crianças. Ao toque, seu corpo parece mais uma rocha do que uma casca de árvore. A extrema aversão de Sudowoodo à água merece nota especial.

descriptions.en: The cry of a male is louder than that of a female. Male Politoed with deep, menacing voices find more popularity with the opposite gender.
descriptions.pt-BR: O choro de um homem é mais alto que o de uma mulher. Homens politizados com vozes profundas e ameaçadoras encontram mais popularidade com o sexo oposto.

descriptions.en: This Pokémon drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, Hoppip links its leaves with other Hoppip to prepare against being blown away.

Skiploom’s flower blossoms when the temperature rises above 64 degrees Fahrenheit. How much the flower opens depends on the temperature. For that reason, this Pokémon is sometimes used as a thermometer.
Jumpluff rides warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. The Pokémon descends to the ground when it encounters cold air while it is floating.
descriptions.pt-BR: Jumpluff aproveita os ventos quentes do sul para cruzar o mar e voar para terras estrangeiras. O Pokémon desce ao solo quando encontra ar frio enquanto flutua.

descriptions.en: This treetop dweller possesses a tail as dexterous as a hand. Ancient writings describe this Pokémon as a one-armed oddity.

Sunkern tries to move as little as it possibly can. It does so because it tries to conserve all the nutrients it has stored in its body for its evolution. It will not eat a thing, subsisting only on morning dew.
Sunflora converts solar energy into nutrition. It moves around actively in the daytime when it is warm. It stops moving as soon as the sun goes down for the night.
Its frail wings are so thin that one can see clear through them. However, during flight these wings exhibit the power to churn air with force enough to launch a house skyward.
When walking on land, it covers its body with a poisonous film that keeps its skin from dehydrating.
Its body is always slimy. It often bangs its head on the river bottom as it swims but seems not to care.
Wields an arcane power with which it can predict the weather and even people's thoughts. When bathed in sunshine, the scarlet orb on its brow glows and builds energy.
descriptions.pt-BR: Exerce um poder arcano com o qual pode prever o tempo e até mesmo os pensamentos das pessoas. Quando banhado pelo sol, o orbe escarlate em sua testa brilha e acumula energia.

descriptions.en: It is most active in the wee hours of the night, when moonlight bathes the land. Its large eyes can pierce the darkness and perceive prey with absolute clarity.
descriptions.pt-BR: É mais ativo nas primeiras horas da noite, quando o luar banha a terra. Seus grandes olhos podem penetrar na escuridão e perceber a presa com absoluta clareza.

descriptions.en: Widely shunned as a bearer of ill fortune. Upon crossing paths with this creature, I've been told one must chant ”Workrum, Workrum—bad luck, don't come” as a protective incantation.
descriptions.pt-BR: Amplamente evitado como portador de má sorte. Ao cruzar o caminho desta criatura, disseram-me que é preciso entoar “Workrum, Workrum – azar, não venha” como um encantamento de proteção.

descriptions.en: Slowking can solve any problem presented to it, but no one can understand a thing Slowking says.
descriptions.pt-BR: Slowking pode resolver qualquer problema que lhe seja apresentado, mas ninguém consegue entender nada do que Slowking diz.

descriptions.en: It conceals itself in darkness, sending chills up travelers' spines with its childlike weeping. As it observes the frightened travelers with glee, the red orbs upon its chest let off an eerie light.
descriptions.pt-BR: Ele se esconde na escuridão, causando arrepios na espinha dos viajantes com seu choro infantil. Enquanto observa com alegria os viajantes assustados, os orbes vermelhos em seu peito emitem uma luz misteriosa.

descriptions.en: It is hard to believe these strangely shaped Pokémon are truly living creatures. I've pointed out that the species' many forms resemble writing from other lands; no one will take me seriously.
To keep its pitch-black tail hidden, it lives quietly in the darkness. It is never first to attack.
Girafarig’s rear head contains a tiny brain that is too small for thinking. However, the rear head doesn’t need to sleep, so it can keep watch over its surroundings 24 hours a day.
descriptions.pt-BR: A cabeça traseira do Girafarig contém um cérebro minúsculo que é pequeno demais para pensar. No entanto, a cabeça traseira não precisa dormir, por isso pode vigiar o seu entorno 24 horas por dia.

descriptions.en: It sticks tree bark to itself with its saliva, making itself thicker and larger. Elderly Pineco are ridiculously huge.
In the moment that it gulps down its prey, the inside of its shell is exposed, but to this day, no one has ever seen that sight.
descriptions.pt-BR: No momento em que engole sua presa, o interior de sua carapaça fica exposto, mas até hoje ninguém jamais viu isso.

descriptions.en: The nests Dunsparce live in are mazes of tunnels. They never get lost in their own nests—they can tell where they are by the scent of the dirt.

Its tail is tipped by a thick, horrible stinger. To bring down prey, it will first obscure their vision by covering their faces with its body, and then it will use the stinger to inject them with venom.
This Pokémon evolved through use of a strange item. Its body is coated with steel powder and notably hard—not even diamond can leave so much as a scratch.
descriptions.pt-BR: Este Pokémon evoluiu através do uso de um item estranho. Seu corpo é revestido com pó de aço e é notavelmente duro – nem mesmo o diamante pode deixar um arranhão.

descriptions.en: In contrast to its appearance, it’s quite timid. When playing with other puppy Pokémon, it sometimes gets bullied.
Although it’s popular with young people, Granbull is timid and sensitive, so it’s totally incompetent as a watchdog.
descriptions.pt-BR: Embora seja popular entre os jovens, Granbull é tímido e sensível, por isso é totalmente incompetente como cão de guarda.

descriptions.en: Fishers detest this troublesome Pokémon because it sprays poison from its spines, getting it everywhere. A different form of Qwilfish lives in other regions.
Evolved by way of a curious item. The shell covering its body has been shown to be stronger than forged steel.
descriptions.pt-BR: Evoluiu por meio de um item curioso. A carcaça que cobre seu corpo demonstrou ser mais forte que o aço forjado.

descriptions.en: The berries stored in its vaselike shell eventually become a thick, pulpy juice.
This Pokémon has an unparalleled horn. Heracross itself demonstrates tremendous power—it's capable of throwing several people trained in the traditional arts of war at once.
descriptions.pt-BR: Este Pokémon tem um chifre incomparável. O próprio Heracross demonstra um poder tremendo – é capaz de derrubar várias pessoas treinadas nas artes tradicionais da guerra de uma só vez.

descriptions.en: Its sturdy, curved claws are ideal for traversing precipitous cliffs. From the tips of these claws drips a venom that infiltrates the nerves of any prey caught in Sneasel's grasp.
It licks its paws because of the sweet honey that has soaked into them. It is cunning, stealing into the nests of Combee and taking for itself the honey that the Combee have amassed.
When the cold season arrives in Hisui, this Pokémon will wander fields and mountains alike in search of its favorite berries. Ursaring's hunger during this time makes it a ferocious danger.
descriptions.pt-BR: Quando a estação fria chega em Hisui, este Pokémon vagará pelos campos e pelas montanhas em busca de suas frutas favoritas. A fome de Ursaring durante esse período o torna um perigo feroz.

descriptions.en: Slugma does not have any blood in its body. Instead, intensely hot magma circulates throughout this Pokémon’s body, carrying essential nutrients and oxygen to its organs.

Magcargo’s body temperature is approximately 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit. Water is vaporized on contact. If this Pokémon is caught in the rain, the raindrops instantly turn into steam, cloaking the area in a thick fog.
descriptions.pt-BR: A temperatura corporal de Magcargo é de aproximadamente 18.000 graus Fahrenheit. A água é vaporizada em contato. Se este Pokémon for pego pela chuva, as gotas de chuva instantaneamente se transformam em vapor, cobrindo a área com uma névoa espessa.

descriptions.en: Swinub excels at sniffing out mushrooms buried beneath grass or snow. Since ancient times, the people of Hisui have often relied upon this skill.
The long fur of this Pokémon covers its eyes, ears, and even limbs, allowing Piloswine to resist harshly frigid conditions. The Pokémon's white tusks can be used to defeat its enemies.
These Pokémon live in warm seas. In prehistoric times, many lived in the oceans around the Galar region as well.
Spits water from its mouth with incredible accuracy. It captures Burmy by shooting them down off the branches from which they dangle.
While Octillery still shoots water from its mouth, the drastic anatomical difference between it and Remoraid meant that for a long time, no one believed the former evolved from the latter.
It has a generous habit of sharing its food with people and Pokémon, so it’s always scrounging around for more food.
This calm and gentle Pokémon swims gracefully through the sea. After building speed, it can leap out of the water. It is often misidentified as a bird Pokémon due to this behavior.
People fashion swords from Skarmory’s shed feathers, so this Pokémon is a popular element in heraldic designs.
descriptions.pt-BR: As pessoas criam espadas com as penas de Skarmory, então este Pokémon é um elemento popular em designs heráldicos.

descriptions.en: They make repeated eerie howls before dawn to call attention to their pack.
Identifiable by its eerie howls, people a long time ago thought it was the grim reaper and feared it.
descriptions.pt-BR: Identificável pelos seus uivos misteriosos, as pessoas há muito tempo pensavam que era o ceifador e temiam-no.

descriptions.en: Scales shed by this Pokémon have such a splendorous gleam to them that they’ve been given to royalty as gifts.
descriptions.pt-BR: As escamas eliminadas por este Pokémon têm um brilho tão esplendoroso que foram dadas à realeza como presentes.

descriptions.en: Phanpy uses its long nose to shower itself. When others gather around, they thoroughly douse each other with water. These Pokémon can be seen drying their soaking-wet bodies at the edge of water.
If Donphan were to tackle with its hard body, even a house could be destroyed. Using its massive strength, the Pokémon helps clear rock and mud slides that block mountain trails.
descriptions.pt-BR: Se Donphan atacasse com seu corpo duro, até uma casa poderia ser destruída. Usando sua enorme força, o Pokémon ajuda a limpar deslizamentos de rochas e lama que bloqueiam trilhas nas montanhas.

descriptions.en: A bizarre item caused this Pokémon to evolve. While it now exhibits many new gestures and expressions, its biology remains inscrutable.
descriptions.pt-BR: Um item bizarro fez com que este Pokémon evoluísse. Embora agora exiba muitos novos gestos e expressões, a sua biologia permanece inescrutável.

descriptions.en: Its strangely shaped antlers have the power to bewitch those who see them. Medicine made by grinding up the black orbs from fallen antlers is an effective treatment for insomnia.
It draws symbols with the fluid that oozes from the tip of its tail. Depending on the symbol, Smeargle fanatics will pay big money for them.
Even though it is small, it can’t be ignored because it will slug any handy target without warning.
After doing a handstand to throw off the opponent’s timing, it presents its fancy kick moves.
descriptions.pt-BR: Depois de fazer uma parada de mão para desviar o timing do oponente, ele apresenta seus movimentos sofisticados de chute.

descriptions.en: This is a very curious Pokémon. Smoochum decides what it likes and dislikes by touching things with its lips.
They generate electricity by spinning their arms. During a thunderstorm, if one hears the lively voices of children out in the wilderness, what one is actually hearing are the voices of Elekid.
This Pokémon lives in volcanic areas. With each breath, sparks spurt from its mouth and nose. When Magby is in good health, its flames gain a yellow tint.
This Pokémon needs to be milked every day, or else it will fall ill. The flavor of Miltank milk changes with the seasons.
descriptions.pt-BR: Este Pokémon precisa ser ordenhado todos os dias, caso contrário ficará doente. O sabor do leite Miltank muda com as estações.

descriptions.en: A kindhearted Pokémon that will care for any sick person or Pokémon until their health improves. The eggs it lays are delicious and bring good fortune to those who eat them.
Raikou embodies the speed of lightning. The roars of this Pokémon send shock waves shuddering through the air and shake the ground as if lightning bolts had come crashing down.
descriptions.pt-BR: Raikou incorpora a velocidade do relâmpago. Os rugidos deste Pokémon enviam ondas de choque pelo ar e sacodem o chão como se raios tivessem caído.

descriptions.en: Entei embodies the passion of magma. This Pokémon is thought to have been born in the eruption of a volcano. It sends up massive bursts of fire that utterly consume all that they touch.
descriptions.pt-BR: Entei incorpora a paixão do magma. Acredita-se que este Pokémon tenha nascido na erupção de um vulcão. Ele envia enormes rajadas de fogo que consomem completamente tudo o que tocam.

descriptions.en: Suicune embodies the compassion of a pure spring of water. It runs across the land with gracefulness. This Pokémon has the power to purify dirty water.
descriptions.pt-BR: Suicune incorpora a compaixão de uma fonte de água pura. Ele atravessa a terra com graça. Este Pokémon tem o poder de purificar a água suja.

descriptions.en: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it will fall asleep so it can grow.
It will not stay still, even while it’s a pupa. It already has arms and legs under its solid shell.
The quakes caused when it walks make even great mountains crumble and change the surrounding terrain.
descriptions.pt-BR: Os terremotos causados ​​quando ele caminha fazem com que até grandes montanhas desmoronem e mudem o terreno ao redor.

descriptions.en: Lugia’s wings pack devastating power—a light fluttering of its wings can blow apart regular houses. As a result, this Pokémon chooses to live out of sight deep under the sea.
descriptions.pt-BR: As asas de Lugia possuem um poder devastador – um leve bater de asas pode destruir casas normais. Como resultado, este Pokémon opta por viver longe da vista, nas profundezas do mar.

descriptions.en: Ho-Oh’s feathers glow in seven colors depending on the angle at which they are struck by light. These feathers are said to bring happiness to the bearers. This Pokémon is said to live at the foot of a rainbow.
descriptions.pt-BR: As penas de Ho-Oh brilham em sete cores, dependendo do ângulo em que são atingidas pela luz. Diz-se que essas penas trazem felicidade aos portadores. Diz-se que este Pokémon vive ao pé de um arco-íris.

descriptions.en: This Pokémon traveled through time to come from the future. It bolsters grass and trees with its own strength, and it can heal wounds, too.
descriptions.pt-BR: Este Pokémon viajou no tempo para vir do futuro. Ele fortalece a grama e as árvores com sua própria força e também pode curar feridas.

descriptions.en: Treecko is cool, calm, and collected—it never panics under any situation. If a bigger foe were to glare at this Pokémon, it would glare right back without conceding an inch of ground.
This Pokémon adeptly flies from branch to branch in trees. In a forest, no Pokémon can ever hope to catch a fleeing Grovyle however fast they may be.
Sceptile has seeds growing on its back. They are said to be bursting with nutrients that revitalize trees. This Pokémon raises the trees in a forest with loving care.
descriptions.pt-BR: Sceptile tem sementes crescendo nas costas. Diz-se que eles estão repletos de nutrientes que revitalizam as árvores. Este Pokémon cria árvores em uma floresta com carinho.

descriptions.en: Torchic has a place inside its body where it keeps its flame. Give it a hug—it will be glowing with warmth. This Pokémon is covered all over by a fluffy coat of down.
Combusken battles with the intensely hot flames it spews from its beak and with outstandingly destructive kicks. This Pokémon’s cry is very loud and distracting.
Blaziken has incredibly strong legs—it can easily clear a 30-story building in one leap. This Pokémon’s blazing punches leave its foes scorched and blackened.
descriptions.pt-BR: Blaziken tem pernas incrivelmente fortes – ele pode facilmente passar por um prédio de 30 andares com um salto. Os socos ardentes deste Pokémon deixam seus inimigos chamuscados e enegrecidos.

descriptions.en: In water, Mudkip breathes using the gills on its cheeks. If it is faced with a tight situation in battle, this Pokémon will unleash its amazing power—it can crush rocks bigger than itself.
Marshtomp is much faster at traveling through mud than it is at swimming. This Pokémon’s hindquarters exhibit obvious development, giving it the ability to walk on just its hind legs.
Swampert predicts storms by sensing subtle differences in the sounds of waves and tidal winds with its fins. If a storm is approaching, it piles up boulders to protect itself.
descriptions.pt-BR: Swampert prevê tempestades sentindo diferenças sutis nos sons das ondas e dos ventos das marés com suas nadadeiras. Se uma tempestade se aproxima, ele acumula pedras para se proteger.

descriptions.en: Poochyena is an omnivore—it will eat anything. A distinguishing feature is how large its fangs are compared to its body. This Pokémon tries to intimidate its foes by making the hair on its tail bristle out.
Mightyena travel and act as a pack in the wild. The memory of its life in the wild compels the Pokémon to obey only those Trainers that it recognizes to possess superior skill.
Zigzagoon that adapted to regions outside Galar acquired this appearance. If you’ve lost something, this Pokémon can likely find it.
It uses its explosive speed and razor-sharp claws to bring down prey. Running along winding paths is not its strong suit.
Likes sap and is abundant in the wild. Why it evolves into various different forms is unknown. One cannot tell from a Wurmple's appearance which form it will take when it evolves.
Wraps itself in thin strings of silk while it stores energy for evolution. It can't extend its limbs and its movement is slow, but its eyes keep a sharp lookout—Silcoon is always on guard.
A colorful and incredibly beautiful but also greedy Pokémon. In an effort to keep its favorite food all to itself, it will chase away Combee as they try to gather nectar.
The silk coating its body is thin but sufficiently strong. Cascoon's silk has a luster and texture superior to that of Silcoon's, and clothes made using Cascoon silk are regarded as top-notch.
Tends to be drawn to bonfires on dark nights. Difficult to chase away from settlements because of the way it scatters highly toxic scales.
Its leaf grew too large for it to live on land. That is how it began to live floating in the water.
It lives at the water’s edge where it is sunny. It sleeps on a bed of water grass by day and becomes active at night.
If it hears festive music, it begins moving in rhythm in order to amplify its power.
descriptions.pt-BR: Se ouvir música festiva, começa a mover-se ritmicamente para amplificar o seu poder.

descriptions.en: It attaches itself to a tree branch using the top of its head. Strong winds can sometimes make it fall.
They live in holes bored in large trees. The sound of Nuzleaf’s grass flute fills listeners with dread.
It lives quietly in the deep forest. It is said to create chilly winter winds with the fans it holds.
descriptions.pt-BR: Ele vive tranquilamente nas profundezas da floresta. Diz-se que cria ventos frios de inverno com os ventiladores que segura.

descriptions.en: Taillow is young—it has only just left its nest. As a result, it sometimes becomes lonesome and cries at night. This Pokémon feeds on Wurmple that live in forests.
Swellow is very conscientious about the upkeep of its glossy wings. Once two Swellow are gathered, they diligently take care of cleaning each other’s wings.
It soars on updrafts without flapping its wings. It makes a nest on sheer cliffs at the sea’s edge.
Skimming the water’s surface, it dips its large bill in the sea, scoops up food and water, and carries it.
Tends to prefer people with a chipper disposition to those who are gloomy, but it has shown no discrimination with regard to age or gender. Needs more research.
It resembles a maiden in appearance, but it wields strange powers to project visions of paradise. I suspect the crimson ornaments on its head are the key to its abilities.
It will dedicate itself to defending a master it has come to adore. Its pure white dress, reminiscent of those worn by ladies of nobility, is the dress of one who is willing to risk their life.
descriptions.pt-BR: Dedicar-se-á a defender um mestre que passou a adorar. Seu vestido branco puro, que lembra os usados ​​pelas damas da nobreza, é o vestido de quem está disposto a arriscar a vida.

descriptions.en: It lives in ponds and marshes that feature lots of plant life. It often fights with Dewpider, whose habitat and diet are similar.
Its thin, winglike antennae are highly absorbent. It waits out rainy days in tree hollows.
If Shroomish senses danger, it shakes its body and scatters spores from the top of its head. This Pokémon’s spores are so toxic, they make trees and weeds wilt.
The seeds ringing Breloom’s tail are made of hardened toxic spores. It is horrible to eat the seeds. Just taking a bite of this Pokémon’s seed will cause your stomach to rumble.
descriptions.pt-BR: As sementes que circundam a cauda de Breloom são feitas de esporos tóxicos endurecidos. É horrível comer as sementes. Apenas dar uma mordida na semente deste Pokémon fará seu estômago roncar.

descriptions.en: Slakoth’s heart beats just once a minute. Whatever happens, it is content to loaf around motionless. It is rare to see this Pokémon in motion.

Vigoroth is simply incapable of remaining still. Even when it tries to sleep, the blood in its veins grows agitated, compelling this Pokémon to run wild throughout the jungle before it can settle down.
Wherever Slaking live, rings of over a yard in diameter appear in grassy fields. They are made by the Pokémon as it eats all the grass within reach while lying prone on the ground.
descriptions.pt-BR: Onde quer que Slaking viva, anéis com mais de um metro de diâmetro aparecem em campos gramados. Eles são feitos pelo Pokémon enquanto ele come toda a grama ao seu alcance enquanto está deitado no chão.

descriptions.en: It can sometimes live underground for more than 10 years. It absorbs nutrients from the roots of trees.
This Pokémon is so quick, it is said to be able to avoid any attack. It loves to feed on tree sap.
A strange Pokémon—it flies without moving its wings, has a hollow shell for a body, and does not breathe.
When Whismur cries, the sound of its own voice startles it, making the Pokémon cry even louder. It cries until it’s exhausted, then it falls asleep.
The force of this Pokémon’s loud voice isn’t just the sound—it’s also the wave of air pressure that blows opponents away and damages them.
This Pokémon can do more than just shout. To communicate with others of its kind, it’ll emit all sorts of sounds from the holes in its body.
descriptions.pt-BR: Este Pokémon pode fazer mais do que apenas gritar. Para se comunicar com outros de sua espécie, ele emitirá todos os tipos de sons pelos buracos em seu corpo.

descriptions.en: There’s a rumor of a traditional recipe for stew that Trainers can use to raise strong Makuhita.
Hariyama that are big and fat aren’t necessarily strong. There are some small ones that move nimbly and use moves skillfully.
descriptions.pt-BR: Hariyama que são grandes e gordos não são necessariamente fortes. Existem alguns pequenos que se movem com agilidade e usam movimentos com habilidade.

descriptions.en: Although Azurill are normally docile, an angry one will swing around the big ball on its tail and try to smash its opponents.
Once the people of Hisui discovered that its red nose always points north, they grew to rely on it greatly when traveling afar. The nose seems to work in a similar way to ancient compasses.
Skitty is known to chase around playfully after its own tail. In the wild, this Pokémon lives in holes in the trees of forests. It is very popular as a pet because of its adorable looks.
Delcatty sleeps anywhere it wants without keeping a permanent nest. If other Pokémon approach it as it sleeps, this Pokémon will never fight—it will just move away somewhere else.
It feeds on gemstone crystals. In darkness, its eyes sparkle with the glitter of jewels.
It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.
When Aron evolves, its steel armor peels off. In ancient times, people would collect Aron’s shed armor and make good use of it in their daily lives.
During territorial disputes, Lairon fight by slamming into each other. Close inspection of their steel armor reveals scratches and dents.
Long ago, there was a king who wore a helmet meant to resemble the head of an Aggron. He was trying to channel the Pokémon’s strength.
descriptions.pt-BR: Há muito tempo, havia um rei que usava um capacete que lembrava a cabeça de um Aggron. Ele estava tentando canalizar a força do Pokémon.

descriptions.en: Meditite heightens its inner energy through meditation. It survives on just one berry a day. Minimal eating is another aspect of this Pokémon’s training.
Through the power of meditation, Medicham developed its sixth sense. It gained the ability to use psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon is known to meditate for a whole month without eating.
It stores electricity in its fur. It gives off sparks from all over its body in seasons when the air is dry.
It rarely appears before people. It is said to nest where lightning has fallen.
descriptions.pt-BR: Raramente aparece diante das pessoas. Diz-se que faz ninho onde um raio caiu.

descriptions.en: When Plusle is cheering on its partner, it flashes with electric sparks from all over its body. If its partner loses, this Pokémon cries loudly.
Minun loves to cheer on its partner in battle. It gives off sparks from its body while it is doing so. If its partner is in trouble, this Pokémon gives off increasing amounts of sparks.
Volbeat’s tail glows like a lightbulb. With other Volbeat, it uses its tail to draw geometric shapes in the night sky. This Pokémon loves the sweet aroma given off by Illumise.
Illumise leads a flight of illuminated Volbeat to draw signs in the night sky. This Pokémon is said to earn greater respect from its peers by composing more complex designs in the sky.
Though beautiful, it has highly poisonous thorns. There is an old tradition in my homeland wherein one would send these thorns to an opponent to challenge them to a duel.
descriptions.pt-BR: Embora bonito, tem espinhos altamente venenosos. Há uma antiga tradição em minha terra natal segundo a qual alguém enviaria esses espinhos a um oponente para desafiá-lo para um duelo.

descriptions.en: Most of Gulpin’s body is made up of its stomach—its heart and brain are very small in comparison. This Pokémon’s stomach contains special enzymes that dissolve anything.
Swalot has no teeth, so what it eats, it swallows whole, no matter what. Its cavernous mouth yawns widely. An automobile tire could easily fit inside this Pokémon’s mouth.
These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.
This Pokémon is known as the Bully of the Sea. Any ship entering the waters Sharpedo calls home will be attacked—no exceptions.
When it sucks in a large volume of seawater, it becomes like a big, bouncy ball. It eats a ton of food daily.
Its immense size is the reason for its popularity. Wailord watching is a favorite sightseeing activity in various parts of the world.
Numel stores magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit within its body. If it gets wet, the magma cools and hardens. In that event, the Pokémon’s body grows heavy and its movements become sluggish.
The humps on Camerupt’s back are formed by a transformation of its bones. They sometimes blast out molten magma. This Pokémon apparently erupts often when it is enraged.
You find abandoned coal mines full of them. They dig tirelessly in search of coal.
Spoink keeps a pearl on top of its head. The pearl functions to amplify this Pokémon’s psychokinetic powers. It is therefore on a constant search for a bigger pearl.
Grumpig uses the black pearls on its body to wield its fantastic powers. When it is doing so, it dances bizarrely. This Pokémon’s black pearls are valuable as works of art.
Each Spinda’s spot pattern is different. With its stumbling movements, it evades opponents’ attacks brilliantly!
It makes an inescapable conical pit and lies in wait at the bottom for prey to come tumbling down.
To help make its wings grow, it dissolves quantities of prey in its digestive juices and guzzles them down every day.
It is nicknamed the Desert Spirit because the flapping of its wings sounds like a woman singing.
descriptions.pt-BR: É apelidado de Espírito do Deserto porque o bater de suas asas soa como o de uma mulher cantando.

descriptions.en: The more arid and harsh the environment, the more pretty and fragrant a flower Cacnea grows. This Pokémon battles by wildly swinging its thorny arms.

If a traveler is going through a desert in the thick of night, Cacturne will follow in a ragtag group. The Pokémon are biding their time, waiting for the traveler to tire and become incapable of moving.
Since Swablu looks like a cumulus cloud, foes can have a hard time finding it. Apparently its wings turned white over many generations.
This Pokémon has a kind disposition, but if it’s provoked, it will threaten opponents with shrill cries before attacking them without mercy.
descriptions.pt-BR: Este Pokémon tem uma disposição gentil, mas se for provocado, ameaçará os oponentes com gritos estridentes antes de atacá-los sem piedade.

descriptions.en: Zangoose usually stays on all fours, but when angered, it gets up on its hind legs and extends its claws. This Pokémon shares a bitter rivalry with Seviper that dates back over generations.
descriptions.pt-BR: Zangoose geralmente fica de quatro, mas quando irritado, ele se levanta nas patas traseiras e estende as garras. Este Pokémon compartilha uma rivalidade acirrada com Seviper que remonta a gerações.

descriptions.en: Seviper’s swordlike tail serves two purposes—it slashes foes and douses them with secreted poison. This Pokémon will not give up its long-running blood feud with Zangoose.
descriptions.pt-BR: A cauda em forma de espada de Seviper tem dois propósitos: ela corta os inimigos e os encharca com veneno secretado. Este Pokémon não desistirá de sua rivalidade sangrenta de longa data com Zangoose.

descriptions.en: It was discovered at the site of a meteor strike 40 years ago. Its stare can lull its foes to sleep.
descriptions.pt-BR: Foi descoberto no local de uma queda de meteoro há 40 anos. Seu olhar pode fazer seus inimigos dormirem.

descriptions.en: Solar energy is the source of its power, so it is strong during the daytime. When it spins, its body shines.
descriptions.pt-BR: A energia solar é a fonte de sua energia, por isso é forte durante o dia. Quando gira, seu corpo brilha.

descriptions.en: Makes its home in swamps with murky water. The poor visibility hides this Pokémon from predators, and the slime on its body makes grasping it difficult.
Strikes its caudal fin against the swamp bed to shake the ground and startle its prey. It will then swallow the fleeing prey whole. People mistook this behavior as the cause of earthquakes.
descriptions.pt-BR: Bate sua nadadeira caudal contra o leito do pântano para sacudir o chão e assustar sua presa. Ele então engolirá inteira a presa em fuga. As pessoas confundiram esse comportamento com a causa dos terremotos.

descriptions.en: It was originally a Pokémon from afar that escaped to the wild. It can adapt to the dirtiest river.
A brutish Pokémon that loves to battle. It will crash itself into any foe that approaches its nest.
descriptions.pt-BR: Um Pokémon brutal que adora lutar. Ele irá colidir com qualquer inimigo que se aproxime de seu ninho.

descriptions.en: It was discovered in ancient ruins. While moving, it constantly spins. It stands on one foot even when asleep.
It appears to have been born from clay dolls made by ancient people. It uses telekinesis to float and move.
descriptions.pt-BR: Parece ter nascido de bonecos de barro feitos por povos antigos. Ele usa telecinesia para flutuar e se mover.

descriptions.en: Lileep clings to rocks on the seabed. When prey comes close, this Pokémon entangles it with petallike tentacles.
Once Cradily catches prey in its tentacles, it digests them whole and absorbs their nutrients.
descriptions.pt-BR: Depois que Cradily captura a presa com seus tentáculos, ele a digere inteira e absorve seus nutrientes.

descriptions.en: Anorith can swim swiftly by pulling its eight wings through the water like oars on a boat. This Pokémon is an ancestor of modern bug Pokémon.
Though it lives on land, it’s also a good swimmer. It dives into the ocean in search of prey, using its sharp claws to take down its quarry.
descriptions.pt-BR: Embora viva em terra, também é um bom nadador. Ele mergulha no oceano em busca de presas, usando suas garras afiadas para derrubar sua presa.

descriptions.en: It is a shabby and ugly Pokémon. However, it is very hardy and can survive on little water.
It’s said that a glimpse of a Milotic and its beauty will calm any hostile emotions you’re feeling.
descriptions.pt-BR: Dizem que vislumbrar um Milotic e sua beleza acalmará qualquer emoção hostil que você esteja sentindo.

descriptions.en: Its form changes depending on the weather. The rougher conditions get, the rougher Castform’s disposition!
descriptions.pt-BR: Sua forma muda dependendo do clima. Quanto mais difíceis ficam as condições, mais difícil é a disposição do Castform!

descriptions.en: Its color changes for concealment and also when its mood or health changes. The darker the color, the healthier it is.
There’s a proverb that says, “Shun the house where Shuppet gather in the growing dusk.”
Resentment at being cast off made it spring into being. Some say that treating it well will satisfy it, and it will once more become a stuffed toy.
descriptions.pt-BR: O ressentimento por ter sido rejeitado fez com que ela surgisse. Alguns dizem que tratá-lo bem irá satisfazê-lo e ele voltará a ser um brinquedo de pelúcia.

descriptions.en: I've heard that the children of Hisui all begin to behave once they've been told the story of how this Pokémon roams about before the witching hour to spirit away misbehaving children.
There are rumors that peeking inside its bandage-wrapped body will cause one to get pulled in through the gaps between the bandages, never to return. I've been too scared to verify.
descriptions.pt-BR: Há rumores de que espiar dentro de seu corpo envolto em bandagens fará com que alguém seja puxado pelas aberturas entre as bandagens e nunca mais volte. Fiquei com muito medo de verificar.

descriptions.en: Bunches of delicious fruit grow around its neck. In warm areas, many ranches raise Tropius.
Can emit waves of air powerful enough to knock out prey taller than itself. I hypothesize that it amplifies the faint sound of wind within its body.
Because of this Pokémon’s ability to detect danger, people mistook Absol as a bringer of doom.
descriptions.pt-BR: Devido à capacidade deste Pokémon de detectar o perigo, as pessoas confundiram Absol com um portador da desgraça.

descriptions.en: It tends to move in a pack with others. They cluster in a tight group to sleep in a cave.
Arrives alongside the first snow. It's thought that homes Snorunt visit will prosper for many generations. By tradition, one might offer a lump of ice made from pure water at one's front door.
It covers its body with an armor of ice harder than steel. Uses its breath to freeze prey, which it then devours as if they were frozen desserts.
descriptions.pt-BR: Cobre seu corpo com uma armadura de gelo mais dura que aço. Usa seu hálito para congelar as presas, que depois devora como se fossem sobremesas congeladas.

descriptions.en: During the season when drift ice approaches the shore, Spheal prefers living on the ice—where fewer predators lurk—rather than the land. Its fur retains heat superbly and resists harsh cold.
Its white whiskers are very sensitive. Sealeo will balance Spheal on the tip of its nose, checking its scent and its feel to be sure the Spheal is healthy.
Its thick tusks are strong enough to shatter drift ice. They have been known to break, but they will grow back by the next year. The Hisui region is well known for these broken tusks.
descriptions.pt-BR: Suas presas grossas são fortes o suficiente para quebrar o gelo. Sabe-se que eles quebram, mas voltarão a crescer no próximo ano. A região de Hisui é bem conhecida por essas presas quebradas.

descriptions.en: Clamperl’s pearls are exceedingly precious. They can be more than 10 times as costly as Shellder’s pearls.
Deep seas are their habitat. According to tradition, when Huntail wash up onshore, something unfortunate will happen.
It sucks bodily fluids out of its prey. The leftover meat sinks to the seafloor, where it becomes food for other Pokémon.
This Pokémon was discovered during deep-sea exploration. Its appearance hasn’t changed in 100,000,000 years, so it’s called a living fossil.
Luvdisc makes its home in coral reefs in warm seas. It especially likes sleeping in the space between Corsola’s branches.
Bagon is a solitary Pokémon that doesn’t form groups with others of its kind. It also has a head hard enough to cleave a boulder in one strike.
Shelgon ignores its hunger entirely, never eating any food. Apparently, Shelgon will evolve once all its energy stores are used up.
While basking in the joy of flight generally keeps this Pokémon in high spirits, Salamence turns into an uncontrollable menace if something angers it.
descriptions.pt-BR: Embora aproveitar a alegria de voar geralmente mantenha este Pokémon animado, Salamence se transforma em uma ameaça incontrolável se algo o irritar.

descriptions.en: The cells in this Pokémon’s body are composed of magnetic material. Instead of blood, magnetic forces flow through Beldum’s body.
Using magnetic forces to stay aloft, this Pokémon flies at high speeds, weaving through harsh mountain terrain in pursuit of prey.
Metagross is the result of the fusion of two Metang. This Pokémon defeats its opponents through use of its supercomputer-level brain.
descriptions.pt-BR: Metagross é o resultado da fusão de dois Metang. Este Pokémon derrota seus oponentes usando seu cérebro de supercomputador.

descriptions.en: Cutting-edge technology was used to study the internals of this Pokémon’s rock body, but nothing was found—not even a brain or a heart.
descriptions.pt-BR: Tecnologia de ponta foi usada para estudar o interior do corpo rochoso deste Pokémon, mas nada foi encontrado – nem mesmo um cérebro ou um coração.

descriptions.en: This Pokémon’s body is made of solid ice. It’s said that Regice was born beneath thick ice in the ice age.
descriptions.pt-BR: O corpo deste Pokémon é feito de gelo sólido. Dizem que Regice nasceu sob gelo espesso na era glacial.

descriptions.en: It’s rumored that this Pokémon was born deep underground in the planet’s mantle and that it emerged onto the surface 10,000 years ago.
descriptions.pt-BR: Há rumores de que este Pokémon nasceu nas profundezas do manto do planeta e emergiu na superfície há 10.000 anos.

descriptions.en: Latias is highly intelligent and capable of understanding human speech. It is covered with a glass-like down. The Pokémon enfolds its body with its down and refracts light to alter its appearance.
descriptions.pt-BR: Latias é altamente inteligente e capaz de compreender a fala humana. É coberto por uma penugem semelhante a vidro. O Pokémon envolve seu corpo com a penugem e refrata a luz para alterar sua aparência.

descriptions.en: Latios will only open its heart to a Trainer with a compassionate spirit. This Pokémon can fly faster than a jet plane by folding its forelegs to minimize air resistance.
descriptions.pt-BR: Latios só abrirá seu coração para um Treinador com espírito compassivo. Este Pokémon pode voar mais rápido que um avião a jato, dobrando as patas dianteiras para minimizar a resistência do ar.

descriptions.en: Kyogre is said to be the personification of the sea itself. Legends tell of its many clashes against Groudon, as each sought to gain the power of nature.
Through Primal Reversion and with nature’s full power, it will take back its true form. It can cause magma to erupt and expand the landmass of the world.
It flies forever through the ozone layer, consuming meteoroids for sustenance. The many meteoroids in its body provide the energy it needs to Mega Evolve.
It’s believed that when this Pokémon wakes from its 1,000-year slumber, it will grant any wishes written on the notes attached to its head.
descriptions.pt-BR: Acredita-se que quando este Pokémon acordar de seu sono de 1.000 anos, ele realizará todos os desejos escritos nas notas anexadas à sua cabeça.

descriptions.en: Deoxys emerged from a virus that came from space. It is highly intelligent and wields psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon shoots lasers from the crystalline organ on its chest.
This Pokémon becomes more energetic the more sunlight there is. The part resembling a shell is similar to silt and is slightly damp and warm to the touch.
Appears where there is clean spring water. The fruit that grows on the shrubs on its shell is sweet, nutritious, and truly delicious.
This remarkable, large-bodied Pokémon would serve beautifully as borrowed scenery for a garden, and its strength is peerless. Torterra roams the wilderness in search of clean water.
descriptions.pt-BR: Este Pokémon notável e de grande porte serviria lindamente como cenário emprestado para um jardim, e sua força é incomparável. Torterra percorre o deserto em busca de água limpa.

descriptions.en: Full of vigor and always in high spirits. It was once known by the name ”Lantern-Tail” and feared as some kind of apparition.
The deeper the blue on its face, the more powerful it will grow to become. It leaps about every which way and lands powerful blows against its opponents with the flame on its tail.
A tall, hardy Pokémon with a dazzling appearance. It shrouds itself in flame and battles as if engaged in dance—truly a sight to behold.
